scope: Independent prospective technical review of unadopted literal-read JS formatting normalization
conclusions: Whole-body anchored narrow grammar uses JSON literal decoding only; no JS or shell evaluation.
Canonicalization yields the original whole-literal spelling and retains exact frozen-command allowlist membership as the approval gate.
Shell text, whitespace, paths, mode and index receive no normalization.
Failed parsing returns original preprocessed body; unknown calls remain unknown.
Only call_body is monkeypatched; original matching, reporting, boundary, audit fields and complete predicate remain unchanged.
The wrapper verifies both source hashes, preserves original source-root behavior, requires an explicit prospective output basename and retains exclusive output creation.
limits: One or two JSON double-quoted strings only; fixed identifiers, keys/order, decimal 24000 and semicolons; not general JavaScript equivalence.
Raw U+2028/U+2029, lone surrogates and escaped surrogate pairs split between literal tokens are rejected.
Original preprocessing still strips outer Unicode whitespace and one leading // @exec: line; malformed pragma without newline inherits IndexError.
Output equality retains original canonical JSON-object semantics and existing extraction, not raw serialized-output byte equality.
Write marker remains a declaration; subsequent arbitrary code still requires the original separate permitted-path/isolation audit.
Hash checking is version binding, not atomic check/import protection, location binding, Python-caller authorization or a sandbox.
Normal imports may create bytecode caches unless disabled; this review used -B. The original import changes sys.dont_write_bytecode globally.
Root resolves from source location; moving identical sources can change data roots.
Prospective output does not automatically embed proposal/review hashes; any future comparison requires separate exact-input bindings.
Finite neutral function-level tests only; no real data or end-to-end proof result, gameplay correctness or resource-exhaustion claim.
future_use_requirements: Keep this proposal unadopted by this review.
Obtain fresh review of exact prospective use and explicit future authorization before adoption.
Preserve existing strict and false reports unchanged; any comparison must be a separately named exclusively created artifact bound to exact proposal/source/review hashes.
Retain separate post-write permitted-path/isolation audit requirement.
